If $b$ is a common solution, subtracting $33$ from both sides of both congruences gives \begin{align*}
b-33\equiv -30\equiv 0\pmod 5\nonumber\\
b-33\equiv -28\equiv 0\pmod 7\nonumber
\end{align*} Since $\gcd(5,7)=1$, we have $b-33\equiv 0\pmod{5\cdot 7}$, that is, $b\equiv 33\pmod {35}$.
